The dropdown placement and applying the order to the current view or filter feel right. The four options cover the basics, but I’d also like **Recently updated** so I can quickly return to links whose notes or details I’ve just changed. Sorting by site isn’t important to me.

It’s fine for the prototype to reset for now, provided the preferences area lets me choose and remember my default order later. With Recently updated added, this sorting behavior is what I want.
